# Gobuster

`gobuster` &middot; _web-applications_

Brute-forces hidden directories and files on a web server using a wordlist.

**Moderate impact.** It touches the target directly; keep the scope tight.

## What this tool needs

- A base URL in scope.
- A wordlist (the runtime ships common wordlists).

## How to use it

Enter a base URL. Gobuster requests each word from a bundled wordlist and reports non-404 responses. Directory brute-forcing generates a lot of traffic; only use it where you have permission.

## Examples

```console
$ gobuster dir -u https://example.com -w /usr/share/wordlists/dirb/common.txt
```

## At a glance

- Category: `web-applications`
- Install with: `apt install gobuster`
- Baseline: yes
- Licence: Apache-2.0
- Upstream: <https://github.com/OJ/gobuster>
